description: Starts a run of a draft stepfile from its text, without adding it to the server. Drive it with stepgate_call and stepgate_submit. Drafts may call only public https URLs, and use only the credentials and settings the operator granted to drafts.

inputs.description: Inputs matching the draft's inputs schema.

stepfile.description: The whole stepfile, as YAML or JSON text.

name: stepgate_try
title: Try a draft stepfile
